system.boundary: Build a Simulink model of a rear-wheel-drive vehicle handling plant.
engineering_objects: Build a Simulink model of a rear-wheel-drive vehicle handling plant.

The model shall contain coupled steering kinematics, dynamic wheel rotation, longitudinal and lateral tyre slip, nonlinear combined tyre-force generation, axle/body load transfer or equivalent force coupling, and longitudinal, lateral, and yaw vehicle dynamics.
Rear-left and rear-right wheel torques shall act through the wheel and tyre dynamics;
physical_paths: Rear-left and rear-right wheel torques shall act through the wheel and tyre dynamics; do not prescribe vehicle motion or slip outputs directly.
Build a Simulink model of a rear-wheel-drive vehicle handling plant.

The model shall contain coupled steering kinematics, dynamic wheel rotation, longitudinal and lateral tyre slip, nonlinear combined tyre-force generation, axle/body load transfer or equivalent force coupling, and longitudinal, lateral, and yaw vehicle dynamics.
Rear-left and rear-right wheel torques shall act through the wheel and tyre dynamics;
functional_paths: The model shall contain coupled steering kinematics, dynamic wheel rotation, longitudinal and lateral tyre slip, nonlinear combined tyre-force generation, axle/body load transfer or equivalent force coupling, and longitudinal, lateral, and yaw vehicle dynamics.
It does not require a yaw-rate feedback controller.
A desired-yaw-rate diagnostic may be computed from the commanded steering and measured vehicle state, but it must not be presented as evidence of closed-loop torque-vectoring control.
information_paths: steering_angle_deg, rear_left_torque_nm, rear_right_torque_nm -> F90-XAUTO-10 plant/control path -> vehicle_motion_state, wheel_slip_state, rear_wheel_command_state
modes_and_events: Build a Simulink model of a rear-wheel-drive vehicle handling plant.

The model shall contain coupled steering kinematics, dynamic wheel rotation, longitudinal and lateral tyre slip, nonlinear combined tyre-force generation, axle/body load transfer or equivalent force coupling, and longitudinal, lateral, and yaw vehicle dynamics.
The model shall remain finite for equal rear torques, changes in the equal-torque level, and small mirrored left/right torque differences at fixed total torque.

interfaces.name: steering_angle_deg
interfaces.description: MATLAB base-workspace input declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: Read the scalar workspace inputs steering_angle_deg, rear_left_torque_nm, and rear_right_torque_nm. Support steering_angle_deg from -6 to +6 degrees and each rear-wheel torque from 15 to 45 N*m.

interfaces.description: MATLAB base-workspace input declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: Read the scalar workspace inputs steering_angle_deg, rear_left_torque_nm, and rear_right_torque_nm.

interfaces.name: rear_right_torque_nm
interfaces.description: MATLAB base-workspace input declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: Read the scalar workspace inputs steering_angle_deg, rear_left_torque_nm, and rear_right_torque_nm.

interfaces.name: vehicle_motion_state
interfaces.description: Output container declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: vehicle_motion_state shall have seven columns in this order: longitudinal velocity (m/s), lateral velocity (m/s), longitudinal acceleration (m/s^2), lateral acceleration (m/s^2), yaw rate (rad/s), yaw acceleration (rad/s^2), and desired-yaw-rate diagnostic (rad/s).

interfaces.name: wheel_slip_state
interfaces.description: Output container declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: wheel_slip_state shall have twelve columns: four longitudinal-slip channels, four lateral-slip channels, and four combined-slip channels, each ordered front-left, front-right, rear-left, rear-right.

interfaces.name: rear_wheel_command_state
interfaces.description: Output container declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: rear_wheel_command_state shall have three columns: steering command (deg), rear-left torque command (N*m), and rear-right torque command (N*m).
